description: njtr1: An R package for researching road safety in New Jersey using open crash data is a software tool described in the paper "njtr1: An R package for researching road safety in New Jersey using open crash data" in Software Impacts (Elsevier, 2021), produced by Gavin C. Rozzi. The abstract could not be read from the open sources used, so the contents are taken from the title. Coverage: not tied to a place or time; the tool is generic. The linked page gives the code or the package; nothing was installed or run, and the repository link comes from a web search for the article, not from the article page. Licence: not stated (no licence on the Software Impacts record read on 2026-10-01; check the repository). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's title and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support road safety analysis of New Jersey crash records. Related: the paper is the Software Impacts article 10.1016/j.simpa.2021.100176.
